messages:
Alex: Heads-up — saw a few support tickets where customers lost v1 behavior when the `X-API-Version` header was omitted. Console toggle says 'opt-in' but traffic silently routed to v2. Anyone else see this?
Maria: Yep, noticed it yesterday on prod. We have a routing fallback that prefers v2 when header missing; that's been default since the shim.
Jamal: The problem is console messaging — the flag reads 'Use v2 when available' but doesn't make that explicit. Ops gets paged because quotas change.
Alex: Example request:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json
# missing X-API-Version header
```
Maria: That's it. The route handler matches tenant default -> no header -> feature flag -> route to v2 pool.
Priya: Quotas blow up because v2 tokens counted differently (dedup + per-request overhead). We need to surface per-route unit rate estimate in console.
Jamal: Proposals: 1) Make console toggle explicit with 'auto-route to v2 when header missing' label + per-route telemetry; 2) Add per-tenant audit log entry whenever fallback routing occurs; 3) Consent UX: a banner that forces opt-in for first N days.
Alex: I like audit log + dashboard signal. For consent banner, big UX lift.
Maria: Technically easy: emit event `version.fallback` with fields: tenant_id, original_header, target_variant. We already have telemetry pipeline for headless events.
Alex: Can we also tag quota meter so billing team sees delta?
Jamal: Meter change is non-trivial—billing pipeline attaches model_name and quantization profile. Fallback loses model_name. We could attach `fallback_source=v1_header_missing`.
DeployBot: Deploy completed: routing-service@v2.14.3 — diff: emit fallback events.
Priya: How fast can we ship console copy change? We should avoid 'silent' term; use 'auto-route to v2 when no version header' with link to docs.
Alex: Action items: Maria to add telemetry event (ETA 2d), Jamal to add quota tag (ETA 3d), UX to update console copy + banner spec (Priya, ETA 1w). I'll open a follow-up runbook thread with checklist.
Priya: Also request QA sample dataset: generate requests without header and with legacy pin header to compare latency + cost.
Maria: I'll add sampling at 0.1% to avoid noise.
Jamal: + add canary in dedicated region before global flip.
Alex: Thanks all. @DeployBot can you re-run routing-service deploy with feature flag default to 'v1-prefer' in staging?
DeployBot: Scheduling rollout to staging cluster now. ETA 12m.
Alex: closing for now, will follow up in runbook thread. :thumbsup:
